update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.71 - Live parent farming session updates
Added ----- - New /parent-farming-session API exposes the in-progress multi-run session (runs completed, best quality grade/score, borrow rotation offset). - The Legacy Parents tab in the Remote Log Viewer now shows a live session footer with multi-run progress. - The Remote Log Viewer now pushes live updates over its WebSocket whenever a parent run completes or the session state changes, so the Legacy Parents tab refreshes automatically instead of only on manual refresh or tab switch.
